content: Hello, thank you for contacting Riverside Payroll Support. How can I assist you with your payment or account details today?
Hi, I wanted to check if my new direct deposit information is set up for this month's payroll. My employee ID is 124067 and I sent the update last week.
Thank you, I see your employee ID 124067 matches our records for Karen T. Liao. Your new payroll account ending in 4421 at Bank of America was successfully registered on June 3rd.
Great, I just wanted to be sure. When should I expect the deposit to hit my account?

Your July payroll, amounting to $2,614.75, is scheduled for release on June 28th. Funds should appear in your account, last four digits 4421, by 9:00 AM that day. Please note, any delays should be reported within 24 hours.
Thanks. Can you confirm the transaction reference for the deposit? My bank sometimes asks for it.

Certainly. The ACH reference for this payroll will be TXN-PY8476113-LIAO, and the sender will display as Riverside Holdings LLC. If your bank needs additional confirmation, you can provide this reference number along with your name and employee ID.
Perfect. For my records, did my last deposit go through without issues? I switched from Chase to Bank of America.

Yes, your previous deposit of $2,587.40 was successfully credited to your new Bank of America account (ending 4421) on May 29th under the same reference sequence. There were no reported holds or errors for that transaction.
Thanks for confirming. If I don't see the funds by the 28th, I'll reach out immediately.
Absolutely. Quick action is best, if you notice any delay, notify us within 24 hours at payroll@riverside.com or call 877-293-0044. We're here to help ensure your pay arrives on time.
